name: Baked Brie in Puff Pastry
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 block (10 ounces) Brie cheese, rind removed and brought to room temperature

steps: Place block of cheese in the middle of sheet of pastry.
Trim off about ½ inch of pastry, and fold pastry over cheese. When you reach the last fold, brush the fold with beaten egg to seal the pastry together.
Brush top with egg and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.
